Shanghai Pudong Airport, June twenty seventeen. An eighty-year-old woman is boarding a flight to Guangzhou.
At the plane, she throws coins at the engine. A prayer for a safe flight.
Other passengers see it and tell the crew.
About a hundred and fifty people get off the plane.
Engineers search the engine. Nine coins: eight on the ground, one inside.
Total value: one point seven yuan. About twenty-five US cents.
The flight leaves more than five hours late. Police take her away.
